Prayer

Talk to God. He listens to you and wants to answer your questions.

What is prayer?

Prayer is the way we communicate with God, our Heavenly Father. It is not a complicated ritual and it doesn't require special words — it is simply talking to Him as you would talk to a loving father who knows you and cares about you.

God wants to hear from you. He wants to hear your joys, your worries, your questions and your thanks. And most importantly: He answers.

How do I pray?

There is no wrong way to pray if you do it sincerely. However, Jesus Christ taught us a simple pattern:

  • Address God: Begin by saying “Heavenly Father” or “Dear God”
  • Give thanks: Express gratitude for the blessings you have received
  • Ask: Share your needs, questions and desires with Him
  • Close: End with “in the name of Jesus Christ, amen”

Does God really answer?

Yes. God answers prayers, though not always in the way we expect. Sometimes the answer comes as a feeling of peace, a clear idea, the words of another person or a door that opens (or closes) in your life.

Learning to recognize God's answers is part of the path of faith. We invite you to try it — pray sincerely and watch what happens in your heart.

Prayer changes lives

Millions of people around the world have experienced the power of prayer. It is not magic — it is a real relationship with a real God who loves you. Prayer gives you strength, direction and peace in the middle of life's storms.

Learn to pray

If you have never prayed, or if you want to deepen your relationship with God, we are here to help.
